input.sql: select r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB, sum(f.PRS_REM_MNT) a from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION r on r.BEN_RES_REG=f.PRE_INS_REG where f.FLX_ANN_MOI=202503 and f.PRE_INS_REG<>99 group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 3
